register_lowering_pattern: register a pattern that matches aten ops and replaces them with inductor IR lowering handlers
register_graph_pattern: register a pattern that matches aten ops and runs a custom handler function on the FX graph
register_replacement: register a replacement rule that traces search and replace functions to generate pattern matching rules
run_pattern_matcher_pass: run a PatternMatcherPass over an FX graph to apply registered patterns and replace matched nodes
convert_fx_graph_to_pattern: convert an FX graph module into a PatternExpr for use in pattern matching and lowering
